question: What price did you hear quoted for a rose, and does the supplied evidence confirm that a purchase was completed?

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The quoted numeric price, without the currency; null if unestablished.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The currency word used in the quote, in lowercase; null if unestablished.

fields.name: purchase_confirmed
fields.description: Whether the supplied evidence confirms a completed purchase. A price quote alone is not purchase confirmation.
